notes: Panels appear once instead of twice. The window is transparent and frameless, and since the previous build made panels start hidden, the first painted frame was empty - so the window was revealed showing nothing, the loader then appeared…

The window is now revealed at the moment the loader has actually been drawn, so it arrives once with the loader already on it. If a panel raises no loader the window is shown regardless after a short wait, so nothing can be left invisible.
